verification.method: scripts/verify/new-zealand.py reads the original UN files directly (not the site's generated data) and compares them with the built page, JSON-LD and CSV; the build itself fails if any sentence-level claim (assertClaim) stops being true; then a hand read of title, description, headline, FAQ and story text.
what: Population 1950–2100, rank, share, growth (slower than Australia), density, land area; about 2.8 times 1950; third in Oceania after Australia and Papua New Guinea
Natural increase and net migration 2026 roughly equal; the 21 net-outflow years listed by period; record inflow 2016
Fertility 1961 high, between 1.85 and 2.25 from 1978 to 2010, 2008/2010/2018/now
Deaths above births from 2047; peak 2078; passes Norway in 2063; table rows 1980 and 2000 negative, projected rows positive
Urban share; title, meta description, headline, FAQ JSON-LD, CSV rows, live counter
against: UN WPP 2024 original file WPP2024_Demographic_Indicators_Medium.csv.gz (SHA-256 286ac36b…, downloaded 2026-11-25) and interim update zip (eb7846bf…) — 63 of 63 checks match
UN WUP 2025 original file WUP2025-F15-National-Definitions_percPop_by_category.xlsx (SHA-256 5fdc43a9…, downloaded 2026-11-25); licence CC BY 3.0 IGO stated in the file
verification.result: All figures match. Comparisons name their size group and region; no causes are stated that the UN data do not show. No image alt text on the page (the flag and charts carry aria-labels).
